column3: Sat behind pace early - urged forward approaching 2f out - third with a furlong left - moved into second inside final 100 yards - stayed on to snatch victory right at the line
Set the pace early - driven on approaching final 2f and battled on inside final furlong - challenged hard in the closing stages and could not find more - caught right at the line for second

Tracked front pair early - third at halfway - urged forward two out - challenged for second inside final furlong - flattened out and gave up the spot 150 yards out - stayed on same gear near the line to finish third
Held up in the pack early - moved into contention by halfway - urged forward into 3rd with 3f left - flattened out in 5th approaching the last furlong - rallied to finish 4th
Held up towards the back - moved into 4th 3f out - asked for effort with 2f left - found nothing more late and slipped to 5th at the line
Held up towards the back - unable to make headway from over 5f out - well beaten at the finish
Sat close to the front pack early - 5th at halfway before losing touch from 5f out - well held at the finish
Held up at the back of the field - made no impression on the leaders - well beaten at the finish
Held up at the back early - improving under pressure 2f out - closed on the front pair inside the final furlong - hit the front 110yds out and stayed on strongly to win
Settled in the pack early - asked for effort with 2f to run - kept responding inside final furlong and looked a threat 110yds out - denied late but claimed second
Settled handy early - asked for effort inside final furlong - hit front briefly close home - overtaken close to the line - held on grimly for third
Sat close to the leading duo - urged forward passing the furlong marker and stayed on to the finish without getting on terms - fourth beaten a length
Slowly away - dropped to last - niggled into contention from halfway - kept on well inside the final furlong to finish closest of all
Went straight to front - pressed for effort inside final furlong - overtaken soon after and unable to quicken - finished 6th beaten 2 lengths
Handy early - driven with over a furlong left - lost momentum inside final furlong - finished 7th
Held a midfield position early - asked for effort with 2f left - drifted left and dropped away inside final furlong - finished eighth beaten 4 lengths
Tracked front pack early - pushed along and faded inside final furlong - finished ninth
Held up towards back of pack - urged forward around halfway - dropped away 2f out - finished well beaten in 10th

Settled in the pack early - improved into 3rd with 5f left - hit the front approaching the final 3f - lost that advantage 2f out - fighting back in the last furlong - rallied to get up right on the line

Settled midpack early - slipped back through the field by halfway - improved into 4th with 5f left - made ground to 2nd approaching the final 3f - nosed in front 2f out - stayed on well up the straight - caught right at the line - finished second
Sat close to the pace early - slipped back to 7th by halfway - up to 6th with 5f left - made ground into 2f out to be third - couldn't threaten those in front - stuck on same gear to the line

Handy early on inner - up with pace-setter by 3f - second at halfway - edged in front 5f out - lost that spot approaching 3f out and slipped to third - fourth passing final furlong then held no rally to finish
Held up early - down the field by halfway - dropped further back approaching 5f out - rallied inside the last two furlongs but held to finish fifth
Held up at back - still 11th at halfway - made ground from 2f out - couldn't threaten leaders and weakened late into 6th
Held up early - still 10th at halfway before creeping into contention over 2f out - couldn't find more late and finished well held
Held up towards the back early - 6th at halfway then 7th with 5f left - moved into 5th approaching 3f out - dropped away in the closing stages to finish well beaten
Settled with leaders early - up to 3rd by halfway - slipped back and driven along 5f out then faded from contention approaching the final 3f
Set the pace early - lost command with 5f left and slipped to fourth soon after as effort was asked for - faded from three furlongs out to finish well beaten
Settled towards the back early - improved into 4th by halfway - dropped down the order 5f from home and slipped to 8th - faded 3f out - well beaten in 11th
Settled off the pace early - moved through into command approaching 2f out - powered clear from the final furlong to score
Settled at the back early - made progress into contention over 2f out - pushed along and kept finding more inside the final furlong to finish second
Settled towards the back early - moved through strongly to close on the leader with over 2f left then pushed along a furlong out - stayed on at one speed to finish third
Settled off the pace towards the back - made progress 3f out then pushed to close on the front group inside 2f out - couldn't find more in the closing stages
Sat close to pace early - pressed for effort then dropped away inside final 2f - held on for 5th
Went straight to front - lost command approaching 2f out - dropped away inside final furlong to finish sixth
Set the pace from the off - edged clear approaching two furlongs out - pushed along and stayed on strongly close home to score
Settled in the pack - squeezed for space and driven on with 2f left - stayed on into 2nd approaching final furlong but couldn't threaten the winner
Held up towards the back of the pack - urged forward with 2f left - shaken up into 5th approaching the final furlong - stayed on well to snatch 3rd near the line
Held up towards back - driven wide approaching 2f out and moved into 4th inside final furlong - nudged into 3rd with under 150 yards left - faded to finish 4th
Sat close to pace early - second at halfway - urged into effort with two furlongs left - lost place late to finish fifth
Slow to break - held up in the pack - asked for effort with 2f left - stayed on late to take 6th
Sat close behind pace - 3rd at halfway - squeezed for space entering straight then asked for effort but found little from 2f out - dropped away last furlong to finish 7th
Held up in the pack early - moved onto the pace by halfway - urged forward on the rail with 2f left but couldn't find more - dropped away final furlong to finish eighth

Sat close to the pace - 5th at halfway - drifted left early in the straight and crowded another runner - driven along 2f out with nothing more to give - dropped away inside final furlong to finish 9th
Sat close to front pack early - hit front two out and driven on - given a squeeze one out - found more to the line for a comfortable win
Settled just behind the leader - urged forward with two furlongs left - driven and well placed entering the final furlong but unable to dent the winner's lead
Held up towards the back - progress from over a furlong out to fight for third approaching the final furlong - stayed on to finish third
Held a central spot through the pack - urged forward with two furlongs left - stayed on in the closing stages without getting near the front
Set the pace early - driven approaching final 2f then overtaken - dropped away final furlong to finish 5th
Held up in the pack - driven approaching final two furlongs - dropped away final furlong - finished sixth
Held up towards the back - driven approaching final 2f - unable to challenge - finished 7th
Tracked the main group early - urged forward to reach the pace 2f out and briefly disputed it - lost touch in the final furlong to finish eighth
Settled in the pack - nudged for effort with over 2f left - weakened soon after - well held at the finish
Slow to break - held up towards the back - pressed for effort with 2f left but found little - finished well beaten in 10th

Settled handy early before slipping back towards the tail approaching the 3rd - sixth by the 8th - improved into contention after the 9th - into third with progress 3 out - narrowed the gap before 2 out - hit the front after the last bend - moving strongly up the straight - pulled away from rivals in the finish to score comfortably

Held up towards the back - into 7th by the 8th - moved into 5th 3 out - advanced into contention entering the last two - up to 2nd before the last - no answer to winner on the run-in - kept on same pace to the line for 2nd

Settled towards the back of the pack early - moved up to third by the 3rd - slipped back to fourth after the 7th - regained third after the 9th - lost that spot again 3 out - unable to threaten in third down the straight and held on for a distant third
Held up early - still back in 8th with three left to jump - unable to make headway in 7th - improved late to finish 4th
Handy early - held 3rd then 4th - forged clear 3 out - jumped awkwardly 2 out and lost front spot - chased hard in 3rd before last - slipped back on run-in - faded to finish 5th

Went straight into command - overtaken briefly at the 2nd - shared advantage from the 4th and back in front after the 5th - yielded top spot 3 out - slipped to third approaching 2 out - faded out of contention before the last

Sat close early - hit the front 2nd then shared the advantage after 4th before being overtaken after 5th - up to second after 7th - dropped back before 2 out - fought on in 4th after 2 out - soon faded and finished well held
Settled towards the back of the field - briefly improved into 5th and 6th - slipped back and lost touch before 3 out - fell further away from the pack after 3 out - pulled up before the last
Sat close to pace early - hit the front approaching 2f out and pulled well ahead - strolled home unchallenged
Settled off the front group early - pushed along 3f out and stayed on at one gait - dug deeper close home to claim second inside the final furlong
Settled off the pack early - pushed along with 3f left - stayed on at one speed from 2f out to finish third
Sluggish start - settled at back of field - pushed along with 3f left and unable to feature - finished well held in 4th
Went straight to front and pulled hard early - overtaken inside final two furlongs and lost place rapidly - allowed to drop away well before the line
Sat behind the front group early - 4th at halfway - urged forward with over 2f left - responded gamely under pressure to hit the front late and score
Held up towards the back - urged forward with two furlongs left - improved into 6th inside the final furlong - stayed on well to snatch second near the line
Tracked the pace - third at halfway - urged forward from 2f out - driven approaching the final furlong - improved to share the front for a moment inside the last 50 yards but faded to finish third
Went straight to front - urged on with over 2f remaining - overtaken with a furlong left and unable to find more from 50 yards out - dropped a couple of spots near the line to finish 4th
Handy early - 5th at halfway - urged forward to 3rd approaching 2f out - hit front inside final furlong - flattened out and passed late to finish 5th
Settled midfield early - slipped towards the back at halfway - driven forward two out - stayed on late to grab sixth near the line
Held up early - fast progress to challenge after 5f - up to 2nd by halfway - asked for effort in early straight but found little from 2f out - 4th with a furlong left - lost place late
Sat close to the front group early - 6th at halfway - driven with over 3f left but made no headway and finished well held
Held up towards back of field - urged into effort entering straight - unable to close from over 2f out - finished 9th
Held up at the back - no impression made through the race - well held at the finish
Tracked front pair early - edged in front two out and asked for effort inside final furlong - kept battling to the line - prevailed by a whisker
Went straight to front under pressure - lost the advantage by a whisker 2f out but fought back - driven out with a real threat in the closing furlong - denied by the smallest margin at the line
Slow to break - held towards back - urged into contention approaching 2f out - moved into third close home - held on for the same over final furlong for third beaten a half-length
Sat close behind leading group early - urged forward with over 2f left - kept responding to finish fourth beaten three-quarters of a length
Slow to break - settled in the pack - urged forward with 2f left - stayed on to finish fifth
Slow to break - settled towards the back of the pack - pushed along with 2f left - stayed on without threatening the leaders
Held up towards back of pack - urged forward approaching halfway - unable to land a blow thereafter - finished well held in 7th
Sat close to the pace early - urged forward with over 2f left - weakened under pressure inside the final furlong to finish 8th
Handy in the pack early - driven for effort with 2f left - dropped away inside the final furlong - finished ninth
Handy early - urged into effort with 2f left - eased back through field late - finished 10th
Held up at the back - failed to get involved - well held in 11th
Sat close to the pace early - fourth turning into the straight after 7th - moved through into second two out - went on before the last and stayed on strongly to score
Went straight to front - stumbled slightly 4 out and lost advantage - pushed along and lost place again before final fence - stayed on to finish but couldn't reel in winner

Settled among the pack early - dropped to 8th by the 8th - began to make progress after 4 out - up to 4th before 3 out - closed into 3rd approaching the last but couldn't reach the front two - stayed on steadily to the line for third

Handy early - moved into contention before 2nd - upsides the pacesetter before 4th then went second after 7th - hit the front after 4 out - slipped to third 2 out - couldn't get competitive again in 4th before last - held no finishing kick and beaten well into fourth
Held up in the pack - still back in 12th after the 8th - moved into contention before 3 out - into 5th by the last but unable to threaten and stayed on same gear to the line

Settled among the pack early - slipped towards the back after the 4th - down in 9th by the 8th - found some improvement approaching four out - unable to get on terms in 6th at the last - kept on same speed up the run-in and drifted wide late
Held up towards the back of the field - still 11th after the 8th before edging into contention but awkward at the last - stayed on same pace to finish 7th
Settled midfield early - still handy before 4th and up to 6th after 7th - improved into contention after 4 out - dropped away following 2 out and faded before the last
Sat close to the pace early - moved into 3rd around the 7th before dropping away approaching 2 out
Sat close up early - still involved after the 4th before slipping to 7th two out later - found a bit of headway 4 out - then gave up ground approaching 2 out - faded before the last
Held up at the back - still 13th after the 8th and unable to close - one-paced from 2 out home to finish well beaten
Held up towards the back - improved into contention around the 7th - dropped away after the 10th - held no chance by 3 out and beaten a long way
Held up towards the back of the pack - into 10th after the 8th before hitting the second-last awkwardly - dropped away from there to finish well beaten
Held up in last place - still down the field around the 8th - dropped away after 4 out and pulled up before 3 out
Settled around midfield and wide of rivals - asked for effort 3f out - moved through to hit the front inside the final furlong - stayed on well to draw away and score
Settled off the pace early - moved through to hit the front two out before being overtaken approaching the final furlong - couldn't find more late and finished second
Held up towards the back - pushed along with 2f left - stayed on at same speed inside final furlong - finished third
Settled off the pace - pressed for effort with 2f left - kept on late to finish 4th
Sat close to pace early - hit front over 3f out - shaken up 2f out before losing advantage - dropped away inside final furlong
Settled off the pace - pushed along with 2f left - dropped away inside final furlong - finished sixth
Went straight to front early - lost the advantage 3f from home and pushed along - dropped away fast inside final furlong to finish well held
Held up at the back throughout - never a factor - finished well beaten in 8th
Led almost throughout - shaken up over 1f out - driven and stayed on strongly inside final furlong - held on for the win

Settled towards back of the pack early - improved into contention by halfway - urged forward with over 2f left - sat 5th a furlong out - stayed on well inside final furlong to snatch 2nd close home - unable to reel in winner
Held up at back - driven approaching final two furlongs and responded well through the last - grabbed third spot near the line
Sat behind front pack early - third at halfway - urged forward on the rail entering final 2f - edged into second inside final furlong then flattened out to finish fourth
Sat close to pace early - second turning for home - urged on with 2f left - lost momentum in the final furlong to finish 5th

Settled in the pack early - moved up to 4th by halfway - asked for effort with 2f left but couldn't find more and slipped to 5th inside the final furlong - dropped one more spot close home to finish sixth
Held up in the pack - urged forward with 2f left - unable to close from over 1f out - eventually beaten well over six lengths in 7th
Held up at the back - no impression made on leaders - finished well beaten in 8th
Sat close to the pace early - slipped towards the back by halfway - stumbled three out then let down the bridle approaching two out - finished a distant last
Set the pace from the off - pushed along a furlong out - continued strongly to the line despite margin shrinking late - always in command - won
Sat close to the front pack early - asked for effort 2f out - moved into second inside final furlong - kept on but couldn't reel in winner
Tracked front group early - urged into effort with 2f left - found more in closing stages to grab third close home
Held up in midfield - asked for effort inside final furlong - stayed on without the speed to get involved - finished fourth beaten 1¾ lengths
Drifted right from the stall - handy early - asked for effort 2f out - drifted right again and driven over 1f out - faded to finish fifth beaten 2 lengths
Slow to break - settled towards the back - urged forward before halfway - driven approaching final furlong - stayed on to finish sixth
Drifted right at the break - settled prominently - asked for effort 2f out - weakened steadily inside final furlong to finish 7th
Bumped early after break - held handy in the pack - driven approaching final furlong - faded close home to finish 8th
Held up midfield - urged for effort 2f out - jockey lost hold of stick soon after - faded through final stages to finish ninth
Settled in the pack early - urged forward approaching halfway - dropped away inside final furlong - finished 10th
Sluggish start - remained towards the back throughout - never a factor and beaten home in 11th

Settled just off the pace early - moved up into the pack after the first - up to 4th by the fifth - progressed into 3rd after the seventh - closed into 2nd approaching two out - hit the front rounding the home turn - opened daylight by the last - stayed on strongly for a comfortable win

Held up towards the back early - improved into 6th by the 8th - made progress into 4th after 4 out - moved into 3rd approaching 2 out - stayed on into 2nd but no match for winner - finished second beaten 17 lengths
Settled midfield early - crept forward to strike the front around the 5th - lost command turning for home - couldn't threaten the winner from there - eased back to third and treaded water to the line

Settled at the back of the field early - lost more ground after the 3rd - up to 7th then back to 6th - scrappy over the 8th - improved to 5th - made progress from two out then stayed on at one level to finish 4th

Settled just behind the pace early - moved through to hit the front after the 4th - blundered after the 5th to lose top spot then erred two out to slip back to third - faded quickly from there to finish well beaten in 5th
Held up towards back - improved into midfield after 4th and up to 6th - scrappy over 8th - lost touch before 3 out after another mistake

Went straight to front - drifted left 4th and soon overtaken - held 3rd then slipped to 5th - back to 4th after 7th - pushed along in 5th after 4 out - lost touch before 3 out - pulled up before the last
Held up at the back - needed encouragement after 3rd - up to 8th before 6th where jump was untidy - lost touch after 7th - dropped away before 4 out and pulled up
Went straight to front early - driven to take command approaching 2f out - sprinted away turning for home - eased down under hand riding through final furlong for a comfortable win
Settled towards the back - pushed along with 2f left - stayed on late to finish second
Settled off the front group early - pushed along and closed in on the pair up front 2f out - stayed on at one speed from inside the final furlong to finish third
Settled off the pace - pushed along with 2f left - dropped away inside final furlong to finish 4th
Settled just behind the pace early - pressed for effort with 2f left - lost touch inside final furlong - eventually beaten home in 5th
Refused to line up with rest of field
Handy behind front group early - third at halfway - driven up into second inside final furlong - edged ahead close home to win
Sent to the front early - roused two out and firmly challenged approaching the final furlong - lost command 150 yards out - stayed on same gear for second
Held up towards the back - urged forward approaching 2f out - still 8th with a furlong left - finished well to snatch 3rd right on the line
Sat just off the front group early - 4th at halfway - asked for effort over 2f out but couldn't find more - stayed on same gait to the line finishing 4th
Settled in the pack early - urged forward with over two furlongs left - moved up to fourth inside the final furlong - couldn't find more and finished fifth holding same effort to the line
Held up in the pack - urged forward with 2f left - driven approaching final furlong - stayed on to finish 6th
Sat close to pace early - second at halfway - asked for effort over 2f out - lost place inside final furlong and faded to finish 7th
Held up towards back of pack - driven approaching 2f out - unable to close from inside final furlong - finished well held in 8th
Slow into stride - settled last of the pack - made no impression - finished well held in 9th
Sat close to front group early - urged forward with over 2f left - lost touch and dropped away inside final furlong - finished well beaten in 10th
Sat behind the pace moving smoothly - hit the front with just over two furlongs left - driven on approaching the final furlong - kept responding to the finish - won going away
Settled in the pack early - improved into contention 3f out - pressed for second inside final furlong - driven to chase leader close home - held but stayed on for second
Settled towards the back of the pack early - made steady progress three furlongs out - urged forward two out and edged closer to the front group - stayed on for third but never able to land the blow
Set the pace early - driven approaching 3f out and lost the front spot inside 2f - rallied in the closing stages to finish fourth
Settled around midfield - urged forward with two furlongs left - kept a steady effort but held to fifth without threatening the front
Held up close to the pace - urged forward with 2f left - weakened under pressure inside the final furlong to finish sixth
Held up towards the back - driven up 3f out to make headway - unable to close the gap over 1f out and dropped away - finished 7th
Settled midfield - urged into effort with over 2f left - lost ground inside final furlong - finished 8th
Slow to begin - held up towards the back - driven with 3f left but found nothing - well held in 9th
Sluggish start - held up towards back - made ground into contention 4f out - driven to stay with leading group over 2f out - lost touch inside final furlong to finish tenth
Handy early - urged into effort with 3f left - faded steadily to finish well beaten in 11th
Settled at the back early - made no impression through the race - finished well beaten in 12th
Settled midfield early - urged forward with 3f remaining - dropped away over 2f out - finished well beaten in 13th

Settled among midfield early - bumped a bit approaching four out - moved up into 4th then 3rd before two out - checked hard in 2nd nearing the home turn and slipped back to 3rd - scrappy jump at the last - rallied to hit the front late on - finished full of running to score
Settled with the pack early - moved into second having been mid-field - hit the front two out - slightly awkward at the last - overtaken late but held effort to the line
Held a midfield position early - improved into 6th before 3 out - made headway 2 out - hit the front briefly rounding the home turn - lost second turning for home - held on for third under pressure

Held up handy early - shuffled back to 5th then 4th - improved into 3rd approaching 3 out - slipped back to 4th before 2 out - unable to threaten front-runners over the last - held on run-in without finding more
Settled behind the pace early - hit the front after the 5th then gave way approaching 2 out - dropped to 5th with nothing left before the last - faded through the finish
Held up early - still back in 12th after 5th - found some late running after two out - up to 9th before the last - stayed on to the line without threatening the front
Held up early - still back in 10th after 5th - crept into contention before 2 out but couldn't threaten in 7th - held no more late and finished 7th
Handy early - up to 5th before 3 out - slipped back approaching 2 out - faded steadily before the last and held to finish 8th
Settled towards the back of the pack - error 4 out - into 7th before 3 out - held no chance approaching last - dropped away on the run-in
Held up towards the back - crept into 9th after the 5th - never threatening those ahead and dropped away before the last - finished 10th
Went straight to front - kicked clear before 2nd - advantage cut after 4th - overtaken and dropped to 3rd after 5th - scratchy over 4 out then dropped away - faded before 3 out
Held up towards the back - still 11th after the 5th and unable to close - dropped away late to finish 12th
Settled towards the back of the field - still holding a similar spot by the 5th - then hit trouble and was pulled up
Settled with leading group - 7th at halfway before blunder at fifth - came down
Held up towards the back - clumsy over 4th - crashed into by another and unseated after 5th
Settled off the pace early - urged along 3f from home - made progress into contention with 2f left - stayed on well over a furlong out to hit the front - kept going to assert late
Sat behind the front group early - pushed along with 2f left before finishing strongly from the final furlong - just failed to peg back winner
Held a midfield spot early - pressed for effort with 2f left - finished strongly late to grab third
Sat close to the pace early - pushed to the front two furlongs out - overtaken and faded inside the final furlong - finished fourth
Hesitant start - held towards the back - pushed along and finished with purpose from 2f out but held for 5th
Dwelt at the start and settled at the back - vigorous driving from 3f out - stayed on to good effect inside the final furlong to finish closest of those beaten
Set the tempo early before going in front - overtaken 2f out - lost touch inside final furlong
Urged to keep tabs early towards the back - pressed for effort with 2f left - stayed on at one speed inside final furlong - finished eighth
Slow to build pace early and settled near the back - pushed along with 2f left - closed late from inside the final furlong to finish 9th
Settled off the pace early - pushed along and dropped away fast inside the final furlong - well beaten in 10th
Held up in the pack - pushed along and dropped away 2f out - well held at the finish
Held up in the pack - pushed along and lost touch inside final 2f - beaten a long way at the finish
Held up at back - improved into midfield with 2f left - pushed along to join leaders inside final furlong - edged ahead close home to score
Up with the pace - hit the front at halfway - driven and challenged hard inside the final furlong - held on gamely but collared near the line - just failed to hold on and went down by half a length
Held up at back of the field - urged forward approaching 2f out to move into third with a furlong left - stayed on at one gait to the line without further improvement
Sat close to the front group early - squeezed for space with over a furlong left - urged on and holding 6th inside the final furlong - stayed on to snatch 4th close home
Went straight to front - lost advantage at halfway - driven approaching final 2f with nothing more to give in 5th - stayed on same gait through closing stages
Sat behind the pace - asked for effort with over 2f left and squeezed for room approaching the final furlong - couldn't find more and slipped back late to finish sixth beaten 5.5 lengths
Held up at the back - made no impression - finished 7th
Held in the pack early - crept onto the leading group's heels by halfway then asked for effort 2f out - had nothing more and dropped away approaching the final furlong
Set the pace early - driven and lost front spot approaching 2f out - stayed in touch and fought back to edge in front inside the final 110 yards - kept on to prevail by the narrowest of margins
Sat close up early - hit front over 2f out - pushed along inside final furlong - lost command close home - unable to find more in the finish
Tracked leading two - urged forward approaching halfway - found extra 3f out and made ground - kept on but lacked the speed to get on terms
Settled just behind the pace - fourth at halfway - moved into second after 3 out - hit the front approaching the home bend - kept on well to score

Sat close to pace early - third at halfway - slipped to fourth after 3 out then fifth after 2 out - rallied into fourth turning for home - found second wind late to take second - edged out narrowly at the line
Settled in the pack early - 5th at halfway - moved into 3rd after two out - edged to 2nd around the home turn - unable to threaten the winner - eased back to 3rd but held the effort to the line
Sat close up early and second at halfway - hit the front after 3 out but lost that spot nearing the home turn and slipped to third - unable to find more in fourth at the finish
Held up at back - still 8th at halfway - found extra pace and made ground from two out - up to 5th by the last - stayed on to the line without threatening the front

Went straight into a slim advantage - unsettled approaching 4 out then blundered 3 out to lose the lead - slipped back to third - down in fourth after 2 out - unable to threaten in fifth around the home turn - lost more ground into sixth before the last
Held up towards the back - slipped to 9th by halfway - lost touch with the pack from 4 out - unable to find more from 2 out and well held at the finish
Held up towards the back - stumbled 4th - up to 6th by halfway - found little after two out - slipped to 7th soon after - faded before the last and allowed to finish in own time
Held up towards the back - still 7th at halfway - slipped further to 8th two out - blundered there and came down
Sat close up early - moved through to hit the front over 2f out under a squeeze - pulled away from rivals inside the final furlong - won without any real effort
Settled in the middle of the field wide of rivals - pressed for effort with 2f left - stayed on steadily to grab second close home
Sluggish start - settled at back of field - pushed along to close in behind leader over a furlong out but couldn't find more late
Set the pace early - pushed along and lost front spot inside final 2f - dropped away in the last furlong to finish fourth
Settled towards back early - moved into contention 3f out then pushed along - lost ground final furlong to finish 5th
Settled in the pack - pushed along with 2f left - dropped away inside final furlong - finished sixth well beaten
Settled off the pace early - pushed along and dropped away rapidly with 2f left - well beaten at the finish

Settled in the pack early - shifted right for space over 2f out then corrected left 2f out - found running once in space with a furlong left - moved into second entering the final furlong - edged in front close home - stuck on to hold on by a whisker
Handy position on inside - closed on pace two out - pushed to hit front - edged left inside final furlong - overtaken close home - stayed on well in defeat

Settled towards the back of the pack early - pushed along approaching the final 2f - made smooth progress on the outside inside the last furlong and a half - moved into third close home - finished strongly for third
Held up towards back - pushed along 3f from home and made gradual progress once asked 2f out - closed on front group entering final furlong - moved into fourth close home - stayed on to finish fourth
Pulled hard early - sat close up behind the pace - pressed for effort with 2f left and lost touch inside final 2f - weakened near the line to finish fifth
Settled in the pack - moved left and began closing the gap approaching 2f out then shifted right after getting squeezed for room inside the final furlong - stayed on at one level to finish sixth
Prominent early - pushed for effort over 2f out then dropped away approaching final furlong - responded to finish stronger and kept trying to line finishing seventh
Towards the back of the field - nudged along from beyond the final furlong without landing a blow

Settled with a strong grip early - up with the pace before hitting the front after 2f - urged along 3f out - pushed along and lost the advantage over 2f out - couldn't find more and dropped away over 1f out - finished ninth
Settled in the pack - pushed for effort with over 2f left - couldn't quicken and dropped away inside the final furlong - finished tenth
